provider_scope: Same checkpoints as cycles 02/03; no substitution.
quality_gate: Unchanged per-checkpoint paired gate: no fewer elimination wins, no more losses/caps or own deaths, no increase in total ticks on common elimination wins, with at least one strict quality improvement. Reject or report a tradeoff otherwise; never call this global optimality.
iteration_stop: One frozen one-factor candidate. Reject if offline screen regresses; do not tune on held-out maps or exceed the call budget. No automatic default promotion.
hypothesis: Cycle02 changed route prior and repeat penalty together; cycle03 survival filtering failed its CPU screen and is rejected without model calls. Isolate only removing the +4 root-route prior, preserving the original .25 repeat penalty and all survival/readout rules. This may break route-feedback loops without over-penalizing necessary tactical revisits.
safety: No cloud, retries, warmups, training or interruption of a user's match. Previously inspected maps are development-only. Fresh held-outs are predeclared and used once.
